MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Assembles and installs a variety of equipment from plans, blueprints and manufacturer's literature. Incumbent uses skills to solve problems that are mechanical in nature and cannot be resolved by other trade mechanics.

S/he operates a metal lathe, milling machine and drill presses and other machine shop equipment to fabricate replacement parts for various items of equipment. 2.

Repairs wheelchairs, carts of various types, hospital stretchers, lockers and other ward equipment; dietetic equipment and utensils, operating tables, IV stands, litters and other items of medical equipment of a mechanical nature. 3.

Incumbent troubleshoots, performs maintenance and repairs on specialty equipment such as pneumatic tube systems, medical air and vacuum pumps, air compressors, industrial emergency generators sets, industrial fans and blowers, dock levelers, trash compactor, floor cleaning machines and other items of equipment that include pneumatics, hydraulics and electric. 4.

Repairs roads and ground equipment such as lawn mowers, tractors, end loaders, street sweepers, forklift, etc. 5. Cuts and welds various metals to make or repair such items as braces, shackles, hangers, etc., for shop equipment and for use by craftsmen of other shops for equipment installations. 6.

The incumbent is frequently called upon to fabricate and install sheet metal duct and accessories for modifications to ventilation and air conditioning ducts and plenums; installs mixing boxes, volume dampers diffusers, etc. 7. Incumbent fabricates replacement parts for hospital equipment.

While not regular and recurring, occasionally designs and fabricates parts for special projects that are unavailable on the open market. Assignments may require special adaptation of conventional machines or the use of specialized or non-conventional machine tools such as jig borers, jig grinders, setup plates, etc.

Occasionally, the incumbent utilizes tools that must be designed by the machinist for specific fabrication processes, or which may involve the machining of surfaces at unusual or compound angles. Often works in tolerances of +/- one thousandth using a variety of depth micrometers, v-blocks, vernier calipers, gauge blocks, dial indicators etc. 8.

The incumbent must communicate with personnel in the departments in which equipment is located or serves relative to problems experienced with equipment, probable solutions and "down times." S/he discusses operating procedures and operator maintenance with user personnel.

S/he talks with other craftsmen regarding installations or repairs in which they will be involved. S/he contacts contractors and supply houses for identifications, sources of supply and availability of units, operating supplies, materials and replacement parts. 9.

Other duties include assisting other journeymen in, and in their absence or when specifically assigned, performing repairs on other equipment and systems as directed by the Supervisor. 10.

Other Duties As Assigned Work Schedule: Full-time, Monday - Friday 08:00am - 16:30pm Position Description Title/PD#: Machinist/PD05870A Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not authorized
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 08/07/2026. EXPERIENCE: A specific length of training and experience is not required, but you must show evidence of training or experience of sufficient scope and quality of your ability to do the work of this position.

Evidence which demonstrates you possess the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties of this position must be supported by detailed descriptions of such on your resume. Applicants will be rated in accordance with the OPM Federal Wage System Qualification Standards.

SCREEN-OUT ELEMENT: Your qualifications will first be evaluated against the prescribed screen out element, which usually appears as question 1 in the on-line questionnaire.

Those applicants who appear to possess at least the minimal acceptable qualification requirement are considered for further rating; those who do not are rated ineligible and are eliminated.

The potential eligibles are then rated against the remainder of the Job Elements: Mechanical Metal Processing and Metalworking Technical Competence Technical Problem Solving Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Note: A full year of work is considered to be 35-40 hours of work per week.

Part-time experience will be credited on the basis of time actually spent in appropriate activities. Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must indicate clearly the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment.

Physical Requirements: Incumbent frequently carries materials and equipment that weigh up to fifty (50) pounds. He/she occasionally must lift equipment weighing one-hundred (100) pounds. In transporting heavy equipment or materials, hand trucks and dollies are used.

He/she makes repairs, adjustments and installations from ladders, scaffolding and platforms where components are in hard-to-reach places. Many installations are in interstitial spaces available only by crawling through the spaces and made additionally more difficult by the necessity of carrying materials and tools.

To further complicate the process, there are ducts, conduits and piping intersecting the crawl-spaces and above ceilings that he/she must transverse. The work also requires prolonged standing and reaching. Therefore, standing, stooping, stretching, bending, reaching, kneeling and crawling are frequently necessary in performing duties assigned.

Working Conditions: Incumbent works in areas where there is dust, dirt and fumes; danger to the skin from flying metal chips and hot metal, and to fingers and hands from close contact with sharp edges, moving cutters and grinding wheels.

Incumbent will be subject to abnormal environmental conditions such as heat, cold, noise, toxic amounts of gas, and the handling of toxic chemicals. Mental application is a necessity due to the complexity of equipment and systems being monitored.

Incumbent must remain alert at all times in order to be prepared for emergency situations and equipment hazards or malfunctions.

# CNC Operator / CNC Fachmann (m/w) #
In dieser vielseitigen Position sind Sie für die termin- und qualitätsgerechte Fertigung von Maschinenbaukomponenten verantwortlich. Diese Aufgabe umfasst das Fertigen von Prototypen bis hin zu kleinen und grösseren Serien auf modernsten mehrachsigen CNC-Bearbeitungszentren.

Zudem sind Sie für die Qualitätskontrolle mittels verschiedenen Messgeräten (konventionell bis 3D-Messtechnik) verantwortlich. Sie unterstützen den Leiter Technik mit konstruktiven Vorschlägen zur Optimierung der Abläufe und Prozesse in der Produktion und arbeiten in div. weiteren internen Projekten mit.
Um in dieser interessanten Funktion erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie eine Grundausbildung in der CNC-Fertigung (Polymechaniker, Mechapraktiker, etc.) sowie einige Jahre Berufserfahrung mit. Zudem haben Sie Erfahrung auf Heidenhain, Siemens und/oder Fanuc Steuerungen.

Sie kommunizieren sehr gut in Deutsch und Englisch, ausserdem verfügen Sie über gute SAP Kenntnisse (von Vorteil). Sie sind im idealalter zwischen 20-50 Jahre alt. Sie sind ein erfahrener CNC-Dreher/Fräser oder Schleifer und bezeichnen sich als belastbaren, flexiblen Teamplayer? Dann sollten Sie sich baldmöglichst bei uns bewerben.
Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Erfüllen Sie das obengenannte Profil? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse und Diplome) an Roman Meister.

## Vorstellung des Unternehmens ##
Meco SA ist die Geschichte eines Unternehmens, das seit 1921 einzigartige Uhrenkomponenten herstellt. Unser Unternehmen befindet sich in Grenchen (SO) und gehört zur Swatch Group, dem weltweit führenden Uhrenkonzern.

Unser Know-how, unsere technologischen Mittel sowie unser Streben nach Innovation ermöglichen es uns, unseren Kunden massgefertigte Projekte vom Entwurf bis hin zur Umsetzung anbieten zu können. Wir sind ein enthusiastisches Team, die jeden Tag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung beiträgt.
Wir legen grossen Wert auf das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter und verfügen über fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen und gute Sozialleistungen. Egal, ob du Deutsch oder Französisch sprichst, dank unserer Sprachenvielfalt und unserer Du-Kultur wirst du dich leicht in unser Team integrieren.
Eine Anstellung bei Meco bringt grosse Vorteile mit sich. Wir unterstützen Aus- und Weiterbildungen und bieten unter anderem kostenlosen Zugang zu einer Sprachlernplattform. Weitere interessante Vorteile bieten sich dir an.
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
**Interessiert dich eine Lehrstelle ab August 2027 ?**

Während deiner Lehre zum/zur Polymechaniker/in EFZ ist es dein Ziel, Werkzeuge, Teile und Vorrichtungen herstellen zu können und Maschinen (konventionelle oder computergesteuerte) zu bedienen, um Serien von kleinen Teilen mit hoher Präzision herzustellen. Du lernst ausserdem, wie man:
* die Sicherstellung der Programmierung und Optimierung
* die Diagnose und Wartung der Geräte bei Störungen.
Du kannst dich auf ein vielfältiges und spannendes Aufgabengebiet freuen!

Du bist ehrgeizig, motiviert und interessierst dich für das technische Umfeld. Du liebst die Genauigkeit, bist fleissig bei der Arbeit und hast die obligatorische Schule abgeschlossen.

As a MACHINIST -Title 32, WG-3414-11, you will perform machining operations and welding to accomplish the manufacture and repair of aircraft components, tools, equipment, parts, and special tools.
GENERAL EXPERIENCE: Experience or training that has provided the candidate with a basic knowledge of machining processes.

Must have the ability to use drill presses, shapers, planers and other types of associated machine tools. ***Trainees Accepted*** SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: To qualify for the WG-3414-11 level, applicant must have at least 18 months experience or training performing a full range of machining operations on most types of conventional or CNC machine tools and their various attachments.

Experience or training in planning and lay out work from blueprints, worksheets and other drawings that may have missing or incorrect information. Skill in applying shop mathematics in establishing needed dimensions, such as those required for chasing threads or machining angular surfaces; locating and marking surfaces and angles to be machined.

Skill in programming machining operations, setting up and operating CNC machine tools.

Knowledge of and ability to apply advanced shop mathematics such as geometric and trigonometric formulas to make computation for laying out work, machining pieces at unusual or compound angles, determining gear ratios pitch, angles and other similar exact or precision dimension.

The ability to provide guidance to others in work related directly to this occupational series.

Set up work and operate state-of-the-art machining centers.
Manufacture parts and items of equipment from raw stock of different kinds of metals such as amor plate and metal alloys and other materials.
Operate Computer Numerical Control (CNC) and Numerical Control (NC) machines to perform standard machining operations.
Plan and layout work from blueprints, sketches, work orders, and/or model of parts to be made.
Use shop mathematics and standard handbook formulas in making computations to establish dimensions not provided in oral or written instructions and specifications.
Calculate mathematical computations and apply handbook formulas for needed dimensions.
Mark surfaces and angles to be machined to facilitate accurate job setups.
Decipher the machinability of numerous metals and the proper tools required to produce the desired cuts and surfaces.
Apply knowledge of various metals and other materials to produce desired cuts and finishes on various metals.
Who May Apply: US Citizens Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social).

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. There is no specific length of training or experience required.

However, you must be able to demonstrate, through experience shown in your written application materials that you possess the sufficient knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the work of this position without more than normal supervision.

Minimum Qualifications (Screen Out Element): Ability to do the work of a(n) Machinist ~ without more than normal supervision.

I have the ability to perform common duties which include lathes, water jets, milling machines, grinding machines and operating computer numerical control (CNC) machines to perform specific machining operation in the machining of castings, forgings, or other raw stocks made of various metals, metal alloys, and other materials.

I can use a variety of auxiliary machine tool attachments; determine speeds, feeds, and coolants, lubricants, or abrasives to be used; and perform precision hand work such as filing, scraping, and lapping to fit, assemble, and finish machined parts.

I interpret work orders or oral instructions accompanied by blueprints, sketches, drawings, sample parts, parts programs or other specifications to determine work procedures, materials, machines, tools, equipment, and attachments to be used during the sequence of machining operations.

I work under normal supervision of a work leader or journey-level employee who observes tasks in progress and upon completion to make sure they are properly performed. - Failure to meet this Screen out Element will result in an ineligible rating.

Physical Effort: The work requires standing, stooping, bending and reaching; and frequent handling of objects weighing up to 10 pounds and occasionally objects weighing as much as 40 pounds. Hoists, hand trucks, lifts and other workers are available to assist with heavier items.

Working Conditions: Works in a well-lighted, heated and ventilated shop with concrete floors. Exposed to dust from grinding, oil from machines, dirt, heat, noise and fumes.

Subject to eye and skin injuries from flying metal chips, abrasive particles and hot metal; skin irritation from contact with coolants, lubricants and abrasive compounds; and danger to the fingers, hands and other parts of the body from cutting tools, grinding wheels, rotating work pieces and moving parts of machine.

# **CNC Operator Fräsen (m/w/d) Medizintechnik** #
Jabil Healthcare ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Healthcare-Design, Engineering und Fertigungslösungen. Gemeinsam mit renommierten internationalen Healthcare-Marken entwickeln und produzieren wir innovative Produkte, die dazu beitragen, die Gesundheit und Lebensqualität von Patientinnen und Patienten weltweit zu verbessern.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Grenchen suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als **CNC Operator Fräsen (m/w/d) Medizintechnik** in einer unbefristeten Vollzeitposition.

Die ausgewählte Person ist für das Bedienen und Überwachen von CNC-Fräsmaschinen zur Herstellung von Komponenten für medizinische Implantate verantwortlich. Das Aufgabengebiet umfasst dabei:
* Bedienen und Überwachen von CNC-Fräsmaschinen gemäss Arbeitsanweisungen, Fertigungsaufträgen und Prozessvorgaben
* Bestücken der Anlagen mit Rohmaterial sowie Entnehmen der gefertigten Bauteile
* Sicherstellen eines reibungslosen und effizienten Produktionsablaufs
* Überwachen der laufenden Fertigung sowie frühzeitiges Erkennen von Prozessabweichungen und Maschinenstörungen
* Durchführen von Serien-, In-Prozess- und Qualitätskontrollen gemäss Prüfvorgaben
* Prüfen der gefertigten Teile hinsichtlich Qualität, Masshaltigkeit und Oberflächenbeschaffenheit mittels Mess- und Prüfmitteln
* Dokumentieren von Prüfergebnissen sowie Erfassen von Produktions- und Qualitätsdaten im MES-System
* Erkennen, Melden und Dokumentieren von Qualitätsabweichungen und Produktionsereignissen
* Fachgerechtes Kennzeichnen und Separieren fehlerhafter oder auffälliger Teile gemäss Vorgaben
